description: Source code for an etcd version monitor in Kubernetes, implementing Prometheus metrics collection, version fetching, and metric rewriting.

classes.name: monitorGatherer
classes.description: Custom Prometheus gatherer that exports rewritten etcd metrics and custom metrics.

classes.name: exportedMetric
classes.description: Defines how specific metrics are rewritten before export.

classes.name: EtcdVersion
classes.description: Struct for unmarshalling etcd version JSON response.

methods.name: Gather
methods.description: Collects and returns all metrics, including rewritten etcd metrics and custom metrics.

methods.name: rewriteExportedMetrics
methods.description: Applies rewrite rules to exported metrics.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Fetches etcd version info and updates the version metric.

methods.name: getVersionPeriodically
methods.description: Periodically fetches etcd version info in a loop.

methods.name: scrapeMetrics
methods.description: Scrapes metrics from the etcd metrics URI.

methods.name: renameLabels
methods.description: Renames labels in a metric family according to a mapping.

methods.name: groupCounterMetricsByLabels
methods.description: Groups counter metrics by label combinations.

methods.name: labelsKey
methods.description: Generates a string key from label pairs for grouping.

methods.name: deepCopyMetricFamily
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a metric family.

methods.name: deepCopyMetric
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a metric.

methods.name: deepCopyLabelPair
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a label pair.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that sets up flags, registers metrics, starts version fetch loop, and serves metrics endpoint.
